questions.text: Open https://bastet-covid.org (German-language tool for Post-COVID/ME-CFS patients preparing a German disability/social-law assessment). Before you start the interview, there's a consent/gate screen explaining what happens to your input. Is it clear from that screen alone what is sent to a third-party AI provider (Anthropic) versus what BASTET itself stores? Quote the exact phrase that told you, or that left you unsure.

Go through the patient interview end-to-end (a few minutes, describe any minor Post-COVID-like symptoms). The design intentionally uses short question blocks and keyword-level answers to accommodate brain fog/cognitive fatigue. Rate how well that actually worked for you as a user.

Look at the final assessment output (GdB/MdE/EMR ranges with cited sources). Does it read as appropriately uncertain/orientational rather than authoritative? Does each number have a traceable source reference, or are some claims unsupported?

Also check the physician-facing arm at https://doc.bastet-covid.org (structured form instead of chat). Does it produce a comparably well-sourced result, or does it feel like an afterthought compared to the patient arm?
Any bugs, broken links, dead ends, or confusing steps you hit anywhere in the flow (either arm)? Be specific — what you clicked/typed and what happened.
Overall usefulness of this tool for someone actually preparing for a German disability/social-law assessment.
